title: Making compost and building a compost bin
summary: Step-by-step guide to making rainy-season compost (green/brown materials/manure, moisture, temperature rise) and building a local compost bin from wood or wire mesh.

pages.title: Introduction to compost making
pages.text: We are going to show you how to set up **your compost** on a **bio-intensive, living-soil** market gardening farm.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Introduction à la fabrication du compost

pages.title: What is compost?
pages.text: It is the process of breaking down waste or **organic matter** through **soil life**, to turn it into a **fertile substrate** that can be used for crops.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Le compost, qu’est-ce que c’est ?

pages.title: Tools needed
pages.text:
To make and use your compost, you will need the following tools:

- **1 measuring tape**
- **1 shovel or 1 hoe**
- **1 watering can**
- **1 empty drum**
- **1 stick** for mixing
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Outils nécessaires

pages.title: Green ingredients
pages.text:
To make compost, you will need **1.5 m³ of green ingredients** rich in nitrogen, such as:

- **Kitchen scraps**
- **Weeds pulled during weeding**
- **Green manure cuttings**
- **Shrub leaves**
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Les ingrédients verts

pages.title: Brown materials
pages.text:
You should also have **1.5 m³ of brown materials** rich in carbon, such as:

- **Dead leaves**
- **Branches**
- **Dry crop residues**
- **Peanut shells**
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Les matériaux bruns

pages.title: Starter and charcoal
pages.text:
You will also need two essential additional ingredients:

- **5 buckets of starter**: cow dung, cow urine, soil or old compost.
- **Charcoal**: the volume of **one large sack (100 kg sack type)** of charcoal powder or small pieces.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Démarreur et charbon

pages.title: Duration and work organization
pages.text:
Setting up the compost is done in **6 steps**.

If all the materials are ready, the job takes no more than **one day for two people**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Durée et organisation du chantier

pages.title: Step 1: Starting the compost
pages.text: Start your first pile in the **1st compartment** of the compost bin, carefully alternating the different layers of organic matter.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 1 : Lancer la fabrication de compost

pages.title: Alternating brown materials, green materials and starter
pages.text: Pile up **brown materials** and **green materials** in turn, adding after each layer a **starter rich in microorganisms**: either cow dung or cow urine, or a bucket of old compost.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Alterner matériaux bruns, verts et démarreur

pages.title: First layer: brown material
pages.text:
The first **30 cm** layer is made with **brown material**.

Sprinkle **one bucket** of one of the starters you have available over it.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Première couche : matière brune

pages.title: Second layer: green material
pages.text:
The second **30 cm** layer is made with **green material**.

Then sprinkle **one bucket** of your starter over it.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Deuxième couche : matière verte

pages.title: Building the pile up to 5 or 6 layers
pages.text: Repeat the process to get **5 to 6 layers of 30 cm**, always finishing with whichever material is most available.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Monter le tas sur 5 à 6 couches

pages.title: Step 2: Moving to the next compartment and mixing the compost
pages.text: After a first phase of decomposition, turning the pile oxygenates the compost and evens out its transformation.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 2 : Transférer de compartiment et mélanger le compost

pages.title: Observing the drop in volume
pages.text: After **2 to 3 weeks**, the raw organic matter has clearly decreased in volume: this is a sign that decomposition is progressing well.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Observer la diminution de volume

pages.title: Moving to the 2nd compartment with charcoal
pages.text:
Using the shovel, transfer the compost to the **2nd compartment** while adding **half a sack of charcoal**.

The outside of the pile should end up in the middle and the center on the outside.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Transférer dans le 2e compartiment avec le charbon

pages.title: Mixing evenly
pages.text: Mix all the materials and the charcoal well to obtain a **uniform pile**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Homogénéiser le mélange

pages.title: Restarting the 1st compartment
pages.text: As soon as the **1st compartment** is empty, start a new batch of compost as described in step 1.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Relancer le 1er compartiment

pages.title: Step 3: Finishing the compost
pages.text: Moving to the **3rd compartment** allows the compost to finish maturing while keeping production going in a continuous cycle.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 3 : Finaliser le compost

pages.title: Another drop in volume after 2 to 3 weeks
pages.text: After **2 to 3 weeks**, the compost in the **2nd compartment** has once again decreased in volume.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Nouvelle baisse de volume après 2 à 3 semaines

pages.title: Moving to the 3rd compartment
pages.text:
Transfer it to the **3rd compartment** while adding the **second half of the sack of charcoal**.

The outer parts should end up in the middle and vice versa. The mix must be **very uniform** at the end.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Transférer dans le 3e compartiment

pages.title: Moving the 1st compartment forward to the 2nd
pages.text: As in step 2, transfer the contents of the **1st compartment** to the **2nd compartment**, adding half a sack of charcoal.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Faire avancer le 1er compartiment vers le 2e

pages.title: Refilling the 1st compartment
pages.text: When the **1st compartment** is free, pile up the ingredients again (brown materials, green materials and starter).
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Recharger le 1er compartiment

pages.title: Keeping the rotation going between the 3 compartments
pages.text:
After **2 to 3 weeks**, empty the **2nd compartment** into the **3rd**, then the **1st** into the **2nd**.

When the 1st compartment is empty, pile up the ingredients again, and so on.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Maintenir la rotation entre les 3 compartiments

pages.title: Step 4: Keep feeding the compost bin
pages.text: Make the most of the whole rainy season to build up enough fertile compost for your crop beds.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 4 : Continuer à alimenter la compostière

pages.title: Production target: 5 m³ of compost
pages.text: Now that you know the **rainy-season composting** technique, repeat these operations throughout the rainy season until you have obtained **5 m³ of compost**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Objectif de production : 5 m³ de compost

pages.title: Step 5: Preparing compost tea
pages.text: In addition to solid compost, you can prepare a living liquid fertilizer that is very easy to apply at the base of crops.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 5 : Préparer du jus de compost

pages.title: Compost tea dosage
pages.text:
Put **2 buckets of compost** in the drum and add **20 buckets of water** from rain, a **borehole** or a well.

⚠️ **Warning**: Avoid using tap water from the public network, which may contain a disinfectant harmful to microorganisms.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Dosage du jus de compost

pages.title: Steeping and stirring the mixture
pages.text:
Stir the mixture **3 times** (for example **once a day for 3 days**).

After **3 days**, your **compost tea** is ready to use.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Macération et brassage du mélange

pages.title: Step 6: Using the compost
pages.text: Find out at which key moments of the crop cycle to apply your solid compost and your compost tea.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 6 : Utiliser le compost

pages.title: Applications suited to each crop stage
pages.text: **Compost** and **compost tea** can be used at different stages of the crop cycle to feed the soil and support plant growth.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Des apports adaptés à chaque phase de culture

pages.title: Amending beds before planting
pages.text: Apply **compost** as an amendment on the beds to prepare the **growing beds**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Amender les planches avant culture

pages.title: Applying compost tea at flowering
pages.text: Sprinkle **compost tea** on the soil when **flowering** begins.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Appliquer le jus de compost à la floraison

pages.title: Applying compost tea at fruiting
pages.text: Sprinkle **compost tea** on the soil when the **fruits and vegetables** start to develop.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Appliquer le jus de compost à la fructification

pages.title: Waste to exclude absolutely
pages.text:
⚠️ **Warning**: Compost is not a garbage bin; not all waste decomposes, and some can even be harmful to the compost and to life in the soil.

**Batteries, plastic bottles, plastic bags**: anything that is not organic has no place in your compost bin.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Les déchets à exclure absolument

pages.title: Ready to make your rainy-season compost
pages.text: **Congratulations!** You now know the technique for making your **rainy-season compost** and using it in your **bio-intensive, living-soil market gardening** crops.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Prêt à produire votre compost d’hivernage
